raw_segments.text: When Sarah entered the holly-hung schoolroom in the afternoon, she did so as the head of
Miss Minchin, in her grandest silk dress, led her by the hand.
A manservant followed, carrying the box containing the last doll, a housemaid carried a second
box, and Becky brought up the rear, carrying a third and wearing a clean apron and a new
Sarah would have much preferred to enter in the usual way, but Miss Minchin had sent for
her, and after an interview in her private sitting room, had expressed her wishes.
